ترتجعي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِعِي (tartajiʕī) /tar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# تُرْتَجَعِي (turtajaʕī) /tur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
